name: BuildJet

modes.label: Native product; see regime notes
modes.note: Incomplete or non-resource economics: rates remain null, never interpreted as free.

caveats: DISCONTINUED: buildjet.com/for-github-actions reads "BuildJet for GitHub Actions has been shut down" (checked 2026-09-28). Regime flagged legacy so it is never priced.

Official homepage says BuildJet for GitHub Actions has been shut down, despite YC Active. Historical 4-vCPU/16GB rate $0.008/min and $300/month per extra 100 concurrent vCPUs are retained as historical only; do not auto-rank a discontinued service.
Inventory exclusion: officially shut down. Card contains no numeric compute modes and no selectable price plan.
Null values mean unknown, not free/unlimited. No model-token cost, tax or unverified ancillary charge included.
Native browser/device/task/credit prices with unknown CPU/RAM are deliberately non-priceable. Check regime before interpreting any partial resource estimate.

fleet.tiers: Default 64 concurrent AMD vCPUs plus a separate 32 ARM vCPU pool. Each $300/month concurrency extension adds 100 AMD or ARM vCPUs, on top of metered usage.
fleet.notes: CI runners rather than persistent general-purpose VMs. default_max_vcpu records the AMD pool, not a combined 96 interchangeable CPUs. At 4 AMD vCPU/runner the default supports 16 runners; fleet sizes depend on runner shape. No extension approval timing or KYC documented.

snapshot_auto.quote: Your code is never saved on our servers after a job is completed.
snapshot_auto.note: Ephemeral GitHub Actions runner VMs; homepage: 'Isolated VM' / 'Complete wipe after every job'. SERVICE SHUT DOWN ('BuildJet for GitHub Actions has been shut down', buildjet.com).

usage_api.quote: In the Billing Portal, locate the section at the top of the page called Current Plan. Click on View Details to expand the section. Here, you can find and view your upcoming invoice, which includes your usage records for the current billing cycle.
usage_api.note: granularity: account-only; cost: yes; BuildJet for GitHub Actions has been shut down. Usage was accessible only through web dashboard Billing Portal (Stripe integration), not via programmatic REST API or SDK. Users could view usage chart and invoices in the dashboard but no machine-readable API endpoint was documented.
